<p class="eyebrow">Labs and data platforms</p>

# Open tools for evidence-centered research and teaching.

I develop public, browser-based projects that connect academic research, classroom learning, and practical analysis. The projects emphasize transparent calculations, documented data sources, reproducible methods, and interfaces that make evidence easier to explore and discuss.

## Featured platform {#housing-market-lab}

::: {.lab-feature .lab-half-card}
<p class="lab-feature-meta"><span>Real estate analytics</span><span>Public data platform</span></p>

### Housing Market Lab

An open, reproducible platform for examining home values, rents, affordability relationships, building permits, inventory, market speed, and listing and sales dynamics. It combines detailed coverage of Southern California communities and ZIP codes with comparisons across major U.S. metropolitan areas.

The platform supports three related uses: helping students interpret local housing conditions, providing researchers with transparent exploratory evidence, and giving policymakers and practitioners ready-to-use measures with documented provenance.

<div class="lab-feature-details" aria-label="Housing Market Lab overview">
<div><strong>Local coverage</strong><span>Los Angeles and Orange County cities, communities, and ZIP codes</span></div>
<div><strong>Metro context</strong><span>Southern California neighbors and major metropolitan areas across the United States</span></div>
<div><strong>Research design</strong><span>Validated releases, source attribution, methodological notes, and reproducible processing</span></div>
</div>

## Real estate teaching tools {#real-estate-teaching-tools}

These interactive tools translate concepts from **FIN 351: Real Estate Principles** and **FIN 355: Real Estate Investment Analysis** into small, inspectable models. They are designed for classroom demonstration and independent exploration rather than automated investment advice.

### Site Feasibility Sandbox

Draw and edit a parcel and building footprints, then connect site geometry, setbacks, lot coverage, stories, and FAR to live development-capacity measures and binding constraints.

[Open the site feasibility sandbox](https://desenlin.com/site-feasibility-sandbox/){.tool-link target="_blank" rel="noopener"}

## Linguistics Teaching Labs {#linguistics-teaching-labs}

::: {.lab-collection-panel .lab-half-card}
<p class="tool-card-meta"><span class="tool-topic">Language and computation</span><span class="tool-level">Collaborative teaching collection</span></p>

### Examine language through evidence and transparent models

Co-developed with [Wei Lai](https://github.com/weilaiPhonetics){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}, Linguistics Teaching Labs brings together the **Nature of Language Lab** and the **Computational Linguistics Lab**. The browser-based activities help introductory students test linguistic claims, work with language data, and inspect how small computational models produce their results.

## People and principles {#people-and-principles}

::: {.lab-about-grid}
::: {.lab-about-card}
<p class="lab-about-label">Creator and maintainer</p>

### Desen Lin

I am an Associate Professor of Finance at California State University, Fullerton. My research and teaching focus on housing markets, real estate finance, urban economics, and applied market analysis. I develop these projects to make data and analytical reasoning easier to inspect, teach, and reuse.

[Research](research.qmd){.lab-text-link} [Teaching](teaching.qmd){.lab-text-link} [CSUF faculty profile](https://business.fullerton.edu/academics/finance/faculty-profiles?user=desenlin%40fullerton.edu){.lab-text-link target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
:::

::: {.lab-about-card}
<p class="lab-about-label">Project principles</p>

### Designed for durable public use

- **Transparent:** calculations, definitions, and source attribution remain visible.
- **Reproducible:** documented workflows support verification and adaptation.
- **Accessible:** projects run in a web browser without a paid account or specialized software.
- **Maintainable:** lightweight architecture and validated releases support long-term stewardship.
:::
:::

The real estate projects are developed and maintained by **Desen Lin**. Linguistics Teaching Labs is a collaborative instructional project created and maintained by **Wei Lai and Desen Lin**, with project-specific attribution provided on the corresponding sites and repositories.
